entries.build_command: make -j$(nproc) NO_RUST=1 NO_ICONV=1 NO_GETTEXT=1 CFLAGS='-O0 -g --coverage' LDFLAGS='--coverage'
entries.reachability_signal: Daemon starts on IPv6 and handles a clone request, meaning lookup_hostname was called for the IPv6 connection
entries.expected_signal: Clone succeeds, content matches, daemon log shows valid IPv6 address (not corrupted/garbage)
entries.input_strategy: IPv6 loopback connection to git daemon triggers the AF_INET6 code path in lookup_hostname()
entries.limitations: Requires IPv6 loopback (::1) to be enabled on the host
